parsed.reason: Description A says the broad except Exception hides programming errors (TypeError, KeyError, AttributeError) as data rejections. Description B says the try also wraps the batch flush, so sink failures discard the pending batch, mislabel a valid row as rejected, and silently lose up to batch_size rows. Both criticize the broad except, but A's failure is bug-masking in parse_row while B's is silent data loss from the flush being inside the try; these are different failures.
